why.en: Acceleration changes how far the cursor moves with the speed of the hand, so aim stops being repeatable.
why.tr: Ivme imlecin ne kadar gittigini elin hizina gore degistirir, bu yuzden nisan tekrarlanabilir olmaz.

apply: $v = $Target -split ','; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseSpeed -Value $v[0]; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value $v[1]; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value $v[2]
revert: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseSpeed -Value '1'; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value '6'; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value '10'
